points.description: States that the algorithm processes/moves through the array one element (position) at a time from left to right (growing a sorted prefix), i.e. the current element/position.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only implies iterating through the array without the left-to-right/current-position idea.

points.description: States that for each current position it finds/identifies the minimum element among the remaining (unsorted) elements.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if it says it finds the minimum/smallest element but does not say it is from the remaining/unsorted part.

points.description: States that the minimum found is swapped with the current element (placed into the current position).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if it says the minimum is moved/placed in position but not that it is swapped with the current element.
